// wheels:generate-auth:services:begin — generated by `wheels generate auth`; re-run with --force to regenerate
// PBKDF2 password hashing + the strategy-registry authenticator.
// The {{strategy}} strategy itself takes constructor arguments, so it is
// built and registered in app/events/onapplicationstart.cfm.
local.di = injector();
local.di.map("passwordHasher").to("wheels.auth.PasswordHasher").asSingleton();
local.di.map("authenticator").to("wheels.auth.Authenticator").asSingleton();
// wheels:generate-auth:services:end
